description: Nibe Limited engages in the fabrication and machining of components in the defense sector in India and internationally. The company operates through two segments: Defence and Aeronautics. The company offers fabrication, machining, and assembly of components used in defence systems, as well as the manufacturing and maintenance of various electronic and mechanical systems for naval, land, air, and space applications. It also provides products and services such as weapons, communication devices, protective vehicles, defensive and deterrence systems, and related components. In addition, the company engages in aeronautics through the hiring and chartering of aircraft and provides aviation services. Further, it offers cable harness, integrated mobile shelter project, modular bridge project, cabel hardness & interconnect systems, missile project, subcontracting projects, electronics testing laboratory, satellite-based intelligence. The company was formerly known as Kavita Fabrics Limited and changed its name to Nibe Limited in July 2020. Nibe Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Mumbai, India.
